purpose: Record the focused Ghidra resolution and native regression for BIENE state-zero MAP-latch polarity.

nonpositive.effect: integrate existing dword velocity at +0x0A; increment +0x2A; after >0x96 reset +0x2A and write +0x2F=1

positive.effect: select +0x2C signed patrol response; subtract orientation<<12 for negative selector or add orientation<<10 otherwise; clamp and integrate

cases: raw MAP 0x4000 present -> mapBlocked=1 and patrol/contact velocity adjustment
raw MAP 0x4000 absent -> mapBlocked=0 and unchanged velocity with phase counter increment

boundary: BIENE states 1-8 still require the startup-built DS:7974 table; its software-float/DOS-time producer remains address-qualified.
